Contributing to softcats

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Bug reports

Please open an issue with a minimal reproducible example, preferably made with reprex, and the output of sessionInfo().

Pull requests

  • Open an issue first for changes beyond small fixes, so that the change can be discussed before work starts.
  • Follow the style of the existing code: roxygen documentation without markdown, [mandatory]/[optional] argument descriptions with types and defaults, lines of at most 80 characters.
  • Add tests with testthat for new behaviour and run R CMD check --as-cran before submitting.
  • Add a bullet to NEWS.md describing the change.
